basis: Lipodystrophy and marfanoid skeleton define syndrome; aortic aneurysm and damaging ocular findings each 1/1. Subcutaneous fat loss and neurologic abnormalities omitted at cap; samples tiny.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: aortic root aneurysm and mitral prolapse each reported in 1/1; cardiovascular disease is an associated manifestation.
decisions.dermatologic: none under cap: subcutaneous fat loss qualifies, but skeletal, metabolic, cardiovascular and vision-threatening manifestations take priority.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: generalized lipodystrophy is a defining disorder of adipose storage and metabolism.

basis: Corneal/retinal disease, deafness and intellectual disability define syndrome; aganglionic megacolon occurs in 30-79%. PDA also 30-79%, omitted at cap in favor of severe bowel dysfunction.

decisions.cardiovascular: none under cap: PDA occurs in 30-79%, but chronic aganglionic bowel dysfunction takes the fourth axis.
decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: congenital aganglionic megacolon causes direct bowel dysfunction in 30-79%; prioritized over PDA under the cap.

basis: Immunodeficiency with anemia/thrombocytopenia, retinal vasculitis and pericarditis each reported in 1/1; panniculitis omitted at cap. Organ-frequency estimates have tiny denominators.

decisions.haematologic: involved: anemia and thrombocytopenia each reported in 1/1 support blood-cell involvement; prioritized over panniculitis.
decisions.dermatologic: none under cap: panniculitis is direct subcutaneous inflammation, reported in 1/1, but blood, retinal and cardiac involvement take priority.

basis: Peroxisomal metabolic disorder; spasticity and callosal atrophy each 2/4, cataracts 3/4. Liver dysfunction lacks sufficient frequency evidence; constipation alone does not establish bowel damage.

decisions.neurologic: involved: progressive neurologic damage includes spasticity and corpus callosum atrophy, each 2/4; the defining mechanism is peroxisomal metabolic dysfunction.

basis: Name and ancestry establish motor peripheral nerve disease. Asymmetry and neuritis alone do not establish the specific immune-mediated multifocal motor neuropathy diagnosis.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: the supplied concept establishes asymmetric motor nerve disease but provides no specific autoimmune or infectious etiology.

basis: Defining skin, nail and dental defects; sensorineural hearing impairment 3/6. Esophageal strictures 2/6 share the GI axis. Asthma 3/6 is a separate associated disease.

decisions.pulmonary: none: asthma in 3/6 meets the frequency threshold but is a separately diagnosed association; direct syndromic airway damage is not established.

basis: Intellectual disability and prominent cranioskeletal malformations characterize syndrome; strabismus 9/10. Irregular dentition 4/9 and delayed eruption 2/6 do not establish lasting dental damage.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: irregular dentition 4/9 and delayed eruption 2/6 lack evidence of substantial structural dental damage or persistent dysfunction.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: prominent cranioskeletal malformations characterize the syndrome, including trigonocephaly 12/13 and multiple common limb abnormalities.

basis: Neurodevelopmental and characteristic dental/palatal defects define syndrome; dentition abnormalities 80-99%. Osteoporosis and tibial bowing each 1/1 support skeletal involvement, with sparse sampling.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: characteristic dental and palatal defects are defining features of the SATB2-associated phenotype; dentition abnormalities occur in 80-99%.

basis: Severe skeletal dysplasia; respiratory insufficiency from thoracic restriction, cleft palate and hearing abnormalities each occur in 30-79%. Nail hypoplasia omitted at cap; proptosis alone excluded.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: respiratory insufficiency occurs in 30-79%; severe thoracic restriction produces substantial pulmonary functional loss rather than an isolated symptom.

basis: Name, ancestry and HPO identify duplication syndrome; cobalamin definition is discordant. Precocious puberty 7/11; structural foot abnormalities 30-79%. No corroborated blood-cell disorder.

decisions.haematologic: none: megaloblastic anemia appears only in a discordant cobalamin-disease definition; ancestry and HPO support the chromosomal duplication syndrome.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: precocious puberty affects 7/11, supporting common endocrine dysfunction; the discordant definition does not establish a primary metabolic disease.
